about.intro_content: Prof. Jian-Hua Fu is Professor of Thoracic Cancers and Director of the Guangdong Esophageal Cancer Institute at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center (SYSUCC), Guangzhou. He is regarded as one of China's most skilled thoracic surgeons, particularly in minimally invasive esophagectomy.
about.detailed_content: Prof. Fu's primary research interest is the comprehensive treatment of esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC), including leading a randomised phase III trial (NCT01216527) comparing neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy plus surgery against surgery alone for advanced ESCC. He has published more than 40 papers in international journals including Annals of Surgery, Annals of Oncology, Journal of Thoracic Oncology and the British Journal of Surgery, plus over 100 papers in Chinese core journals. He holds leadership roles across national thoracic surgery and oncology societies including CACA, CSCO and the Chinese Association of Thoracic Surgeons.

faq.section_heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Prof. Jian-Hua Fu

items.question: Does Prof. Jian-Hua Fu accept international patients?
items.answer: CancerFax can coordinate medical report review and consultation support for international patients seeking an opinion related to esophageal or lung cancer surgery at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center, subject to hospital availability and case acceptance.

items.question: What is Prof. Fu's area of specialisation?
items.answer: Prof. Fu specialises in the surgical and multimodal treatment of esophageal squamous cell carcinoma, particularly minimally invasive esophagectomy, and also performs lung cancer surgery.

items.question: How can I request a consultation or second opinion?
items.answer: Submit your medical reports through CancerFax. The CancerFax team reviews the documents, prepares the case for submission, and coordinates next steps with SYSUCC's International Medical Center, subject to availability.

items.question: Does Prof. Fu perform minimally invasive esophageal cancer surgery?
items.answer: Yes. Prof. Fu is regarded as one of China's most experienced surgeons in minimally invasive and robot-assisted esophagectomy for esophageal squamous cell carcinoma.

items.question: Is Prof. Fu involved in clinical trials for esophageal cancer?
items.answer: Yes. Prof. Fu has led multiple clinical trials, including a phase III trial comparing neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy plus surgery against surgery alone, and ongoing studies combining immunotherapy with neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy.
